Creative Marketing Coordinator

The Feldman Agency (TFA)

Location: Toronto, ON | Full-Time | In-Office

Salary: $50,000-$70,000 CAD annually, depending on experience and qualifications

About TFA

The Feldman Agency is one of Canada's leading live entertainment agencies, representing a diverse roster of artists and working with promoters, festivals, casinos, theatres and venues across North America.

Our business spans artist representation, talent buying, concert promotion and live event programming.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a hands-on Creative Marketing Coordinator who enjoys creating content, executing campaigns and seeing projects through from concept to completion.

This is an active, production-focused role for someone who can design compelling graphics, edit engaging videos, execute digital marketing campaigns and create promotional materials for concerts, tours, venues and represented artists.

You'll work across multiple projects in a fast-paced live entertainment environment, helping connect artists and events with audiences across Canada.

We're looking for someone who enjoys doing the work-not simply overseeing it. You should be comfortable working directly in creative and marketing platforms, managing your own deliverables and producing quality work under tight deadlines.

What You'll Be Doing

Graphic Design & Creative Production
• Create and adapt concert posters, show artwork, digital advertisements, social media graphics and artist promotional materials.
• Produce creative assets for concert announcements, ticket on-sales, tours and venue marketing campaigns.
• Resize, format and prepare artwork for different digital platforms and advertising specifications.
• Maintain consistent branding and attention to detail across all creative materials.

Video & Social Media Content
• Edit short-form promotional videos, concert clips, artist reels and social media content.
• Create engaging content for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube and other platforms.
• Write captions, schedule posts and maintain social media content calendars.
• Assist with capturing photo and video content at concerts and live events.

Digital Marketing Execution
• Build and support digital advertising campaigns through Meta Ads and Google Ads.
• Develop advertising creative and assist with audience targeting by market, genre and fan interests.
• Execute marketing activities supporting concert ticket sales, artist promotion and venue awareness.
• Monitor campaign performance and make recommendations for improvements.

Email Marketing & Artist Promotion
• Design, build and schedule email marketing campaigns, including concert announcements, newsletters and artist mailers.
• Create promotional materials showcasing TFA's roster to promoters, festivals, talent buyers and industry partners.
• Maintain email lists, marketing assets and campaign materials.

Campaign Coordination
• Manage assigned projects, creative deliverables and deadlines from start to finish.
• Work with internal teams and external partners to gather information, assets and approvals.
• Track campaign results, including engagement, advertising performance and ticket sales trends.
• Support multiple simultaneous campaigns while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.

What We're Looking For
Strong graphic design and video editing skills, supported by a portfolio of completed work.
• Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator and Premiere Pro, as well as Canva or comparable creative software.
• Experience creating content for social media and digital advertising.
• Working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads and digital marketing fundamentals.
• Experience using email marketing platforms such as Hive, Mailchimp or similar.
• Strong writing and proofreading skills.
• Excellent organization, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.
• Comfortable working independently, taking initiative and following projects through to completion.
• A collaborative attitude, willingness to learn and genuine interest in music and live entertainment.

Nice to Have
• Experience in concert promotion, music marketing, artist representation, festivals or live events.
• Hands-on experience launching and optimizing paid digital advertising campaigns.
• Experience with photography, motion graphics or live event content capture.
• Familiarity with ticketing platforms such as Ticketmaster.
• Experience coordinating radio, media or other promotional advertising.
• French-language proficiency.

Why Join TFA?

You'll work with a diverse range of artists, genres, concerts and venues while gaining practical experience across multiple areas of the live entertainment industry.

This is an opportunity to put your creative and marketing skills to work on real campaigns, contribute ideas and see the results of your work in the marketplace.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a portfolio or examples of work you've personally created, including graphic design, video editing and, where available, digital marketing campaigns via Isarta

We're especially interested in seeing examples that demonstrate your creative skills, attention to detail and ability to execute projects from start to finish.

Recruitment Information

Position Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at The Feldman Agency.

Use of Artificial Intelligence: TFA uses artificial intelligence tools to assist in screening and evaluating job applications as part of our recruitment process.

The Feldman Agency is committed to fair and equitable employment practices. Accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process in accordance with applicable Ontario legislation.

SUMMARY:

The Loyalty Marketing Specialist supports the planning, coordination and execution of the Moi Rewards program in Ontario, connecting coalition priorities with banner and cross-functional marketing plans. The role works closely with Ontario and Quebec marketing teams across food and drug, as well as Digital Marketing, E-commerce, CRM, Merchandising, Operations, Finance, Customer Care, Loyalty Analytics, Customer Insights and external partners. The Specialist helps ensure loyalty offers, campaigns and communications are delivered accurately, efficiently and consistently across channels. The role also supports loyalty marketing financial administration—including budgets, forecasts, purchase orders, invoices, project costs and reconciliations—and uses data, automation and AI-enabled tools to improve planning, productivity, decision-making and campaign performance.

SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Support the annual and long-range planning process for Moi Rewards in Ontario, helping align coalition priorities with banner, Digital Marketing, E-commerce, CRM and broader marketing plans.

• Support integration across Ontario and Quebec marketing teams in food and drug by coordinating priorities, calendars, dependencies, inputs and decision points.

• Build, maintain and track integrated workback plans for loyalty campaigns and initiatives, following up on deliverables and helping ensure timely, accurate and consistent execution across channels.

• Partner closely with CRM to support offer management and personalized communications, including audience inputs, personalized newsletters and loyalty messaging in weekly customer emails.

• Collaborate with Merchandising on offer development and assessment, supporting analysis of point issuance, redemption, customer behaviour, funding and overall program economics.

• Support the development of measurement frameworks and success criteria for Moi Rewards initiatives; work with Analytics and Customer Insights to review results and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

• Support the loyalty marketing budget, forecasts and monthly reconciliation process by maintaining accurate project, commitment and expenditure tracking.

• Coordinate with Finance on purchase orders, invoices, accruals, budget reporting and reconciliations; investigate variances and escalate issues as required.

• Maintain a current view of campaign commitments and costs, preparing timely budget updates and identifying risks, opportunities and potential trade-offs for the Manager and key stakeholders.

• Support creative development and agency workflows by preparing briefs, coordinating reviews, consolidating feedback and recommendations, protecting brand consistency and tracking costs and timelines.

• Use AI, automation and other productivity tools to strengthen planning, accelerate analysis and content development, reduce manual effort and improve the quality and speed of execution.

• Support offer development, reporting and KPI tracking, and prepare insights and recommendations designed to increase trips, basket size and member engagement.

• Coordinate loyalty communications and issue resolution with Customer Care and Business Services, helping ensure teams are prepared for campaigns and customers receive accurate, consistent support.

• Support post-campaign reviews with CRM, Analytics, Customer Insights and partners; document actionable learning and help incorporate it into future offers, communications and plans.

• Build effective working relationships across Moi Rewards, banner marketing, Digital Marketing, E-commerce, Merchandising, Operations, Finance, Research, Analytics, agencies, vendors and other cross-functional partners.

QUALIFICATIONS:

• 3-5 years of experience in customer relationship marketing, direct marketing, loyalty marketing or a related field.

• Bachelors degree in Marketing, Commerce, Business Administration or equivalent.

• Solid understanding of retail loyalty, direct marketing, KPI management, merchandising and store operations.

• Strong proficiency with Microsoft 365 productivity and automation tools, including Microsoft Copilot, Power Automate, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Power BI, Microstrategy and Microsoft Loop; experience creating and maintaining practical AI-enabled workflows or agents is an asset.

• Strong financial acumen and hands-on experience with cost estimates, purchase order creation and tracking, invoice reconciliation, forecasting and budget administration.

• Strong interpersonal, written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and collaborate with stakeholders at different levels of the organization.

• Critical and creative thinker with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects concurrently using tools such as SharePoint Lists, Loop pages and Loop components.

• Ability to explain loyalty concepts and recommendations to varied audiences, including senior leaders, operations and merchandising partners and store teams.

• Demonstrated ability to develop clear, accurate and actionable creative briefs and collaborate with media and creative agencies on campaign strategy, asset development and execution while working within established processes and brand standards.

RELATIONSHIPS:

• Internal: Senior Management, Loyalty Marketing, Brand Marketing, Market Research, Communications, CRM, Digital Marketing, E-commerce, Merchandising, Operations, Finance, Analytics, Customer Insights, Customer Care, Business Services and IT

• External: Vendors, suppliers, media and creative agencies, and customers

The role

At Altis, we believe great results start with great relationships, and that's just as true in marketing as it is in recruitment. We're looking for a digital marketer who can help us start more of those relationships by connecting employers and job seekers with the services and opportunities they're looking for.

In this role, you'll help turn our digital presence into a consistent source of qualified leads. You'll develop and run campaigns, improve how people find us through search, and look for opportunities to turn website visitors into meaningful conversations with our team.

We're looking for someone who enjoys the challenge of figuring out what makes people take action. You'll be curious about what employers are searching for, why some campaigns bring in better leads than others, and how small changes to an ad, landing page or website experience can make a measurable difference.

You'll work across paid advertising, SEO, AI search visibility, website optimization and analytics, with a shared goal of helping Altis generate more qualified leads and grow our business.

What you'll do

Your main responsibilities will include but may not be limited to the following:

• Generate qualified leads: Identify opportunities to attract employers looking for recruitment services and candidates exploring new opportunities. Develop and execute digital initiatives that increase inbound inquiries, improve lead quality and support business growth.

• Manage paid advertising: Build, launch and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn and other relevant platforms. Conduct keyword research, manage budgets, test ad copy and targeting, and continually improve performance based on cost per qualified lead and conversions.

• Grow our organic search visibility: Conduct keyword research, optimize website content and manage technical SEO for altis.com. Monitor site health using tools like Google Search Console and Semrush, identifying and resolving issues related to indexing, metadata, redirects, site structure and page performance.

• Improve our visibility in AI search: Monitor how Altis appears in ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity and other AI-powered search tools. Identify opportunities to improve our visibility through content optimization, structured data and other emerging AEO/GEO practices.

• Create content that performs: Write and optimize landing pages, website copy and other search-focused content. Work with our content team to identify opportunities, develop SEO briefs and improve existing content to attract the right audiences.

• Improve website conversion: Build and optimize landing pages, forms and calls to action in Webflow. Analyze how visitors interact with our website, identify friction points and test improvements that help turn more traffic into employer inquiries and candidate applications.

• Evaluate and optimize marketing technology: Explore, implement and manage third-party SEO, AI search and digital marketing automation platforms. Assess new tools, optimize how we use them and identify opportunities to automate tasks, improve performance and make our marketing more efficient.

• Measure what matters: Use GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console and CRM data to track website traffic, campaign performance, conversions and lead quality. Maintain accurate tracking, report on results and recommend improvements based on what the data tells us.

• Collaborate across teams: Work closely with Sales, Recruitment, Content, Design and external partners to understand business priorities, develop targeted initiatives and continually improve our digital marketing results.

What we offer

You will work in a collaborative environment where curiosity, quality, and clarity are valued. This team balances high standards with trust and flexibility, offering space to think deeply and contribute meaningfully. You will have exposure to thought leadership, and long-term brand-building initiatives, all within a culture that values balance, respect, and professional impact.

What you bring

• 3-5 years of hands-on digital marketing experience, including experience developing and executing campaigns designed to generate leads, inquiries, applications or other measurable conversions.

• A strong understanding of how digital marketing contributes to business growth, with experience optimizing campaigns for lead quality and results.

• Hands-on experience with Google Ads, including campaign setup, keyword research, audience targeting, budget management and optimization.

• Experience with LinkedIn advertising or other paid social platforms, ideally in a B2B environment.

• Working knowledge of SEO, including keyword research, on-page optimization and tools such as Google Search Console and/or Semrush.

• Experience using GA4 and other analytics tools to evaluate campaign performance, track conversions and identify opportunities.

• Familiarity with website content management systems and landing-page optimization. Experience with Webflow is an asset.

• Strong writing skills and the ability to create clear, compelling digital copy that encourages people to take action.

• An analytical and curious mindset. You enjoy testing ideas, understanding why something worked (or didn't) and finding ways to improve.
